async function json<T>(provider: string, response: Response): Promise<T> {
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw IntegrationError.make({
      provider,
      status: response.status,
      retryable: response.status === 429 || response.status >= 500,
      message: `${provider} returned HTTP ${response.status}`,
    });
  }

  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

class MailBlueProbe {
  async contactByEmail(email: string): Promise<MailBlueContact | null> {
    const response = await this.http.request(
      `${this.baseUrl}contacts?filters%5Bemail%5D=${encodeURIComponent(email.toLowerCase())}`,
      { provider: 'mailblue', headers: this.headers() },
    );

    const result = await json<{ contacts: ReadonlyArray<MailBlueContact> }>('mailblue', response);

    return result.contacts[0] ?? null;
  }
}
